question: For the four current Z200 and separately unadopted Z180 cleat/post axes, determine whether the saved 4-inch bolt dimension box already suffices for projection/seating, what a 4.5-inch full-body comparison gains or loses, and the source-bound drilling/tool/removal requirements. No capacity, tool fit, model adoption or observations.

bolt_4in.listing_identifies: SAE J429 Grade 5, 3/8-16, partially threaded, ASME B18.2.1, 4in +0/-0.06in, minimum thread1in, 9/16in wrench

washer.listing_identifies: USS ASME B18.21.1, OD0.993-1.030in, ID0.433-0.453in, thickness0.064-0.104in; numeric yield not supplied

socket_example.scope: Unselected product example. External dimensions lie inside the old conditional OD22/length65 envelope. Hex depth is not total bolt-well depth. Relief bore/depth, engaged drive intrusion, actual dimensions and current installed clearance are unknown.

primary_product_reading.reading_scope: Primary pages were read, and the original socket dimension graphic inspected in memory. No order, purchase, availability guarantee, retained raw external asset, or supplier/lot qualification. Frozen catalog dimensions govern the arithmetic; observed prices agree with that dated basket.

missing_inputs_and_design_disposition: Retain the existing partially threaded 4in family as the first dimensional proposal. Its projection and conservative grip-gaging comparisons are positive. Full smooth bearing is not guaranteed by the listed body minimum.

The 4.5in family can supply a larger minimum smooth body over the model bearing interval, but its upper grip-gaging bound cannot guarantee the nut reaches this short stack. It is a comparison only. Do not add washer packing, trim bolts, reverse the installation or substitute full-thread stock.

Per-stack dimensional acceptance inputs are delivered length L, sound seated receiver stack S, each own washer thickness, nut height/pitch and active threads, actual body/transition/root profile, gaged grip, free nut seating and washer/fillet seating. Actual worksheet cells remain blank.

The separate retained UNRC-2A/steel-core-root proposal is a conditional purchase hypothesis: for3/8-16 it proposes7.31774mm root/no-undercut floor over threaded AND transition bearing regions. A generic UNC listing or UNR gage does not establish this floor. No root or wood resistance is calculated here.

SAE J429 Grade5 with the existing92ksi minimum tensile-yield/F606 hypothesis is a design specification, not observed delivered conformance or a new bending coupon. Matching nut/washer standards do not establish washer numeric yield or combined resistance.

A guide19.05mm and backer travel6.35mm require101.6mm usable cutting reach/projection for the nominal76.2mm matched pair. Exact bushing ID/OD/length/fixation, datum registration/stops, independent member supports, clamps/backer footprint and drill/chuck/bit envelopes remain needed. Overall bit length alone is insufficient.

The installation reference for3/8in timber holes is13/32-7/16in; the current Z200 four-station maximum-hole conflict stays HOLD. Z180 is unadopted. Registration, guide clearance/tilt, bit runout/drift, receiver seating and hole size need an explicit error budget against the current geometry.

Specify a9/16in tool with clear tip well exceeding the required nut-plus-protrusion depth plus its actual seating/drive allowance, or an appropriate pass-through tool. External socket fit alone cannot qualify its internal well, drive intrusion, counterhold, hand space or handle sweep.

The recorded socket/extension/remote-handle envelopes and L+2mm bolt removal convention are reusable query inputs only. Current clearance needs source-bound continuous approaches/removals and supported assembly/disassembly order. No old swept-clear pass transfers.

Nominal washer-seat proof does not cover every catalog ID/thickness/fillet corner. A washer ID smaller than the maximum wood hole leaves an inner strip over the void; effective contact area needs its own disposition. Thin head washers may expose fillet beyond the washer. Do not silently claim full support or use bolt tightening to draw parts together.
limits: Pure JSON/CSV and scalar dimension arithmetic. Source pin closure here authenticates direct scalar inputs and all ten retained receiver-seat files; no old force field or component resistance is consumed or transferred.

ASME B18.2.1-2012 Lb/Lg values are the retained uncoated full-body hex-cap-screw scenario. Vendor edition, finished coating and delivered dimensions remain separate; Lg is not an observed first full-form thread.
Possible thread/runout lengths measured from Lb minimum are conservative exposure diagnostics, not observed threaded lengths, an automatic quarter-bearing failure, or a strength pass.
Nominal stock/pair thicknesses are not actual measurements. New proposal changes only Z; all100current axes and66current screws remain authoritative and unchanged.
Guide/backer sizes, conditional tool outlines and removal travel are planning inputs. No CAD import/build/query, native method, frame solve, physical test or observed access is performed.
No model/viewer/source/evidence replacement, shared documentation edit, staging, commit, part purchase, torque/preload or physical operation is authorized by this receipt.
